images.title: Four children playing Statue
images.purpose: Put the Statue game in front of the student before any turn is named: four children in a row at the start, and the same four frozen after the call, not all facing the same way.
images.composition: Two panels side by side on one baseline, the first headed Before and the second headed After STATUE, each with four children labelled A, B, C and D.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Two rounded panels with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline and a very pale cream #FFF8E7 fill: the left panel spans x 50 to 700 and y 110 to 740, the right panel x 756 to 1406 and y 110 to 740. Panel headings in dark #1F2937 sans-serif (44 px, bold), centred at y 160: Before over the left panel and After STATUE over the right panel. In each panel stand exactly 4 children in a row on a ground line at y 640 (a thin grey #6B7280 line, 560 px long), their centres 140 px apart. Left panel centres at x 190, 330, 470 and 610; right panel centres at x 896, 1036, 1176 and 1316. Each child is a flat friendly figure about 90 px wide and 250 px high standing on the ground line: a round head (56 px), a short-sleeved shirt (a rounded rectangle 84 px wide, 110 px high), shorts and two legs with shoes. Shirt colours from the left: child A teal #0072B2, child B amber #E69F00, child C green #009E73, child D reddish purple #CC79A7, the same in both panels. LEFT PANEL: all four children face the front, each with two small dark eye dots and a small smile on the face. RIGHT PANEL: child A is seen from the back (dark hair covers the whole head, no face), children B and C face the front exactly as in the left panel, and child D is seen from the side facing right (one eye dot and a small nose bump on the right of the face). Under each child, centred at y 700, the letter A, B, C or D in dark #1F2937 sans-serif (40 px, bold). No arrows, no numbers and no fractions anywhere. Nothing else in the frame.

any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any arrow, turn name, fraction or answer written anywhere in the frame
more or fewer than 4 children in a panel, or a child with a different shirt colour in the second panel
images.takeaway: The same four children, before and after the call, are not all facing the same way.
images.description: Four children in a row facing the front, and the same four after the call STATUE with A facing away, B and C facing the front and D facing the side.
images.context: Concept image for the hook, The Statue Game. It follows the idea of the two pictures in your maths book (children turning around, then frozen) and gives no answer.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student look at who faces where, but do not say full turn or half turn on this picture. The slip to watch is thinking that a child who faces the front again has not turned at all.

image_decisions.why: The two pictures of the four children, before and after the call, put the hook question in front of the student without giving the answer.
